reply: {"sentences":[{"text":"The recommended dose of Orvelan is 5 mg once daily.","cites":["PI-ORV-US@2#2"]},{"text":"The dose may be increased to 10 mg once daily after 4 weeks, and the maximum daily dose is 10 mg.","cites":["PI-ORV-US@2#2"]},{"text":"If a dose is missed, it should be taken as soon as possible on the same day.","cites":["PI-ORV-US@2#3","SRD-ORV-MISSED-DOSE@1#2"]},{"text":"If the next day has already started, the missed dose should be skipped and the next dose taken at the usual time.","cites":["SRD-ORV-MISSED-DOSE@1#2"]},{"text":"Two doses should never be taken on the same day.","cites":["SRD-ORV-MISSED-DOSE@1#2","PI-ORV-US@2#3"]}]}
